run_update_clang: run the script to download and update prebuilt clang binaries for the current platform
download_url_with_retry: create a function that downloads a URL with retry logic and progress dots
download_and_unpack_tarball: create a function that downloads a tarball URL and extracts it to a directory
read_write_stamp_file: create functions to read and write a stamp file tracking the current clang build revision
remove_directory_tree: create a function that recursively removes a directory tree handling read-only files
